statement: Change-scoped CI distinguishes package-lock root release metadata from the installed dependency graph: a coordinated version-only release edit receives the release-packaging modular proof, while any dependency graph change, missing comparison, or malformed lockfile still refuses with RELEASE_PROOF_REQUIRED.

constraints.statement: Do not exempt package-lock.json by path or by its presence beside package.json; compare the before/after lockfile graph and fail closed when that comparison is unavailable.
Any package dependency, lockfile dependency node, resolution, integrity, engine, peer, bin, or other installed-graph change must continue to refuse modular proof with RELEASE_PROOF_REQUIRED.
A root version-only package-lock change is not inert: it routes through the existing release-packaging subsystem together with package.json and the remaining release metadata.
Do not rerun, skip, weaken, or route around the red CI gate; repair the selector contract and require fresh exact-SHA CI before tagging.

After the final source attempt, obtain independent verification of version-only admission, real graph-change refusal, malformed/missing fail-closed behavior, and end-to-end range derivation before landing.
